title: Padang-Style Coconut Poached Chicken (Ayam Pop)
description: Tender chicken poached in coconut water and coconut milk, served with a rich fried sambal and a silky coconut milk gravy — a classic Padang restaurant favourite.
description_ms: Ayam yang direbus dalam air kelapa dan santan sehingga lembut, dihidang dengan sambal goreng yang kaya dan kuah santan yang licin — kegemaran restoran nasi Padang.
steps: Place chicken in a pot with 4 bruised lemongrass stalks, a knob of ginger, 5 bruised garlic cloves, 3 cup coconut water, 1/4 cup coconut milk and 1 tsp salt.
Simmer until the chicken is cooked through; remove chicken and set aside. Reserve the poaching liquid.
[Sambal] Blend 1 tomato, 15 bird's eye chillies, 1 onion, 5 garlic cloves and 1 roasted shrimp paste block with a little oil (not water).
Fry the sambal paste over medium heat, adding 2 sliced kaffir lime leaves; cook until the oil separates and the colour is deep.
Add a little water and 2–3 tbsp coconut milk; season with salt, sugar and seasoning powder. Continue cooking until glossy and the oil separates.
[Kuah] Add coconut milk (0.5 small box), sugar and water to the reserved poaching liquid; thicken with a cornstarch slurry.
Optionally boil cassava shoots in salted water and serve alongside.
Plate the chicken; top with sambal and pour the coconut milk gravy over.
steps_ms: Masukkan ayam dalam periuk bersama 4 batang serai diketuk, seketul halia, 5 ulas bawang putih diketuk, 3 cawan air kelapa, 1/4 cawan santan dan 1 sudu kecil garam.
Rebus sehingga ayam masak; angkat ayam dan ketepikan. Simpan air rebusan.
[Sambal] Blend 1 biji tomato, 15 biji cili padi, 1 biji bawang merah, 5 ulas bawang putih dan 1 ketul belacan yang dibakar dengan sedikit minyak (bukan air).
Goreng pes sambal atas api sederhana bersama 2 helai daun limau purut yang dihiris; masak sehingga pecah minyak dan warna gelap.
Tambah sedikit air dan 2-3 sudu santan; tambah garam, gula dan serbuk perasa. Sambung masak sehingga berkilat dan pecah minyak.
[Kuah] Masukkan santan (setengah kotak kecil), gula dan air ke dalam air rebusan ayam tadi; pekatkan dengan air tepung jagung.
Boleh rebus pucuk ubi kayu dalam air bergaram dan hidang bersama (pilihan).
Susun ayam di atas pinggan; letak sambal di atas dan tuang kuah santan.
